name: DEIS (tab mode)
plain: A multistep exponential integrator: past slopes are weighted by coefficients integrated numerically along a VP noise schedule. In core that schedule is fixed by hard-coded EDM-to-VP constants. No node exposes its options, so sampler name means order 3, tab mode.
math:
Symbols: x current latent; σ=sigmas[i]; σ'=sigmas[i+1]; D=denoised (x0 prediction after CFG); U=uncond_denoised; d=(x−D)/σ. 
edm2t maps σ to VP time t with ε_s=1e-3, σ_min=0.002, σ_max=80 constants. Each step: order=min(3,i+1), forced to 1 when σ'≤0; weights c_j=Σ over 10000 points of I(τ)·L_j(τ)·Δτ, with L_j the Lagrange basis in t and I(τ)=−½(dlogᾱ/dτ)/√(ᾱ(1−ᾱ)).
Order 1: x'=x+(σ'−σ)d; otherwise x'=x+c₀d+c₁d₁(+c₂d₂).

props.prediction_space: slopes in σ, interpolated in VP time t
props.final_sigma0: t_next≤0 forces order 1, so the last step is Euler and equals D; coefficients for that interval are computed but not used.
props.flow_const: No CONST branch. The fixed VP constants apply to all models.

claims.text: deis.py comment: reimplementation of qsh-zh/deis via diff-sampler, Apache 2

label: from code
surprise: σ_min 0.002 and σ_max 80 are default arguments of edm2t, never taken from the model, so coefficients do not follow the actual model schedule. rhoab mode exists but no core path sets it, and by reading it would raise on unpack from i=3 with order 3 (not run).

audit.note: "Each step: order=min(3,i+1)" omits the override at sampling.py:1308-1309: when σ'≤0 order is forced to 1, so the last step is Euler whatever the history.
